profile.headline: Autonomous Vehicle Prediction Software @ Latitude AI | PhD in Robotics @ Carnegie Mellon University
profile.summary: I'm very interested in using technology to bring real, positive change to those in the world who need it most. Opportunities founded in the principles of philanthropy, sustainability, health, education, and the furthering of man-kind interest me greatly. I'm especially interested in personalized medicine and biomedical devices.

positions.title: Prediction Software Engineer
positions.description: Design and implementation of inference and forecasting for vehicle autonomy.

positions.title: Graduate Student Researcher
positions.description:
- Researching novel approaches to modeling, sensing, and control of soft structures for applications in locomotion, manipulation, and wearable technologies.
- Prototyping battery-free wearable biometric sensing to continuously capture photoplethsymographs for heart rate and blood oxygen saturation monitoring.
- Investigating friction-tunable material interfaces for locomotion and sensing applications.

positions.title: Auton Lab Senior Research Programmer and Analyst
positions.description:
- Performed data analysis and software development tasks toward applied research aimed at solving many difficult and societally important problems including: detection of human trafficking to aid police force and investigators in attacking the problem; detection, localization, and classification of radiation sources to protect against security threats; and analysis of patient vital signals to detect instability.
- Converted high level research algorithms into scalable real time applications, including a computer vision pipeline for extracting blood vessels, velocities, and flow patterns in videos of microvascular bloodflow.
- Applied machine learning methods to complex problems, including the detection of bleeding in pig models using featurized vital sign data. Methods included training various classification and regression models (logistic regression, neural networks, random forests, etc), validating them in a cross validation framework, and evaluating performance through ROC and AMOC curves. Clustering approaches used as well, e.g. K-means for grouping similar subjects.
- Optimized code for memory and time complexity and implemented algorithms using a variety of parallel processing frameworks (e.g. multithreading in C++ with OpenMP, pthreads; in R with doParallel and foreach packages; multiprocessing in Python and MATLAB; using hadoop on compute clusters; and moving video processing to the GPU using the C/C++ CUDA, CUDNN, and CUFFT APIs).
- Predominantly developed with C/C++, Python, R, and MATLAB languages, including building wrappers to incorporate high-performance C/C++ software in the interpreted languages (e.g. using boost::python, Rcpp, and MATLAB mex).

positions.title: Engineering Research Intern
positions.description:
- Designed a hardware test apparatus for characterizing material degradation in the presence of a high-voltage (6kV) electric field. The intent was to look at the effects of ion migration as a failure mode for thermal interface material degradation, as it is very relevant to such materials used in close proximity to high voltage electronics such as electric vehicles. 
- Investigated a novel and easy to fabricate sensor design using liquid metal embedded elastomers and custom electronics to enable localized continuum shape sensing using a simple four-wire interface.

positions.title: ASIC Design Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Developed system test automation suite to streamline the unit testing of individual GPU modules and characterize their performance in terms of power and computational efficiency in a repeatable manner.
- Debugged microcode on unique microprocessors incorporated in GPU ASIC, including APU power management control inefficiencies.

positions.title: Computer Science Tutor
positions.description: Developed a custom curriculum for a high school student to learn computer science by building up technical fluency by finding real world applications to solve in line with the student's interests.

positions.title: Software Engineer, Embedded Applications
positions.description:
- Developed, tested, and integrated operational flight program software implementing built-in-test and safety critical software components on GPS/INS guided projectile. Updated and maintained software for performing vehicle guidance, navigation, and control, device communication, and telemetry.
- Supported off-site projectile launch and flight tests, system integration efforts, and software development efforts with customers, subcontractors, and prime contractors.
- Developed and utilized various levels of test frameworks for the system including module level unit testing, software simulation, and hardware in the loop (HIL) simulation involving integration with satellite constellation simulators, 6DoF vehicle dynamics simulation, and environmental force simulators. Debugged embedded software on PowerPC running VxWorks RTOS.
- Interacted with subcontractors and clients on solving issues and supporting off site hardware and software HIL configurations, including to independent verification and validation efforts.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Made substantial modifications to integration test tools graphical user interface and functionality for evaluating function, behavior, and performance of a tri-mode seeker (radar, infrared, laser guided).
- Developed GUI tools on Windows and Linux using Qt and MFC frameworks, and embedded operational flight program software on PowerPC running Integrity RTOS, debugged with MULTI.

positions.title: Web Application Developer
positions.description: Developed web software for a variety of clients involving database application development in ASP and VBScript using MSSQL, or PHP with MySQL.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Rebuilt backend of in-house web tools using PHP and MySQL.
- Reimplemented C++ simulations in Java the in-house simulation frameworks.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Computer Engineering - Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning

volunteerExperiences.description:
- Controlled music, audio, and lighting in Sunday performances for young children in Sunday school.
- Lead and coordinated a group of about twenty volunteers in a cleanup project of a local elementary school.

- Developed mathematics curriculum for, taught, and evaluated classrooms of about 160 middle school students in a rural, francophone community.
- Developed lessons and experiments for a week-long science camp.
- Organized a three day, multi-city bike tour to discuss malaria and prevention in rural villages.
